notes: Customer item discounts (ST_CUST_ITEMS): grid per customer and item (the legacy CUSTOMER master block is the customer column); line rules as the class discounts (group, unit, retail price, MOH discount, ranges, no repeated item, item of the line's class), button to load a class's items for a customer (APP_RULES3_SA). Wave 3b: legacy customer / item / unit lists (units of the item cascading), item name and unit factor shown.

row_rules.ST_CUST_ITEMS:
-- legacy line WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM / PRE-INSERT: active group of the item, unit (basic by default), retail price and MOH discount,
-- price 0..99999.99, non-negative discounts / bonus, no repeated item per customer, item registered in the line's class
app_rules3_sa.disc_line_row('ST_CUST_ITEMS', inserting, :new.customer_code, :new.class_code, :new.item_group_code, :new.item_code, :new.unit_code,
  :new.sales_price, :new.disc_ratio1, :new.disc_ratio2, :new.disc_ratio3, :new.bonus_ratio, :new.extra_bonus_ratio);

ST_CUST_ITEMS.ITEM_CODE.lov: select it.item_code || ' - ' || nvl(it.name_a, it.name_e) d, it.item_code r from st_item it, st_item_unit iu where nvl(it.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and it.item_group_code = iu.group_code and it.item_code = iu.item_code and nvl(iu.basic_unit, 0) = 1 order by 2

ST_CUST_ITEMS.UNIT_CODE.lov: select u.unit_code || ' - ' || u.name_a || decode(iu.basic_unit, 1, ' (وحدة أساسية)', '') d, u.unit_code r from st_item_unit iu, st_unit u where iu.item_code = :PAGE_ITEM_CODE and (iu.group_code = :PAGE_ITEM_GROUP_CODE or :PAGE_ITEM_GROUP_CODE is null) and iu.unit_code = u.unit_code order by 2

ST_CUST_ITEMS.CUSTOMER_CODE.lov: select nvl(to_char(old_code), '-') || ' / ' || code || ' - ' || name_a d, code r from customer where nvl(stopflag, 0) = 0 and nvl(customer_status, 0) = 1 order by code

ST_CUST_ITEMS.ITEM_NAME.sql: (select max(nvl(i.name_a, i.name_e)) from st_item i where i.item_code = t.item_code and i.item_group_code = t.item_group_code)

ST_CUST_ITEMS.NDB_FACTOR.sql: (select max(u.factor) from st_item_unit u where u.item_code = t.item_code and u.group_code = t.item_group_code and u.unit_code = t.unit_code)
